headline: Trump faces Apple-Micron clash over Chinese memory chips - WSJ
summary: Investing.com -- Apple and Micron Technology are pressing the Trump administration to take opposing positions on the use of Chinese memory chips, forcing the president to weigh lower consumer prices against his goal of expanding domestic semiconductor production, The Wall Street Journal exclusively reported.
